content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The COREMERCH infrastructure allows digital creators to build their own sovereign online stores without relying on traditional payment platforms that impose high fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut on every sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference means that as you scale your sales, more of your revenue stays in your pocket. For example, with 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you would retain an additional $921 by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad. This is not just about saving money; it's about having full control over your sales and customer relationships.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH stack is built on a combination of free and open-source tools that provide everything a digital creator needs to operate their online store. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, creators can ensure their stores are always available. The backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, facilitating secure payment processing and automated product delivery. By integrating NOWPayments, you gain the ability to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that your revenue is maximized from every transaction. The architecture is designed for resilience and independence, empowering creators to operate without ongoing platform dependencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is tailored for digital creators across regions where traditional payment systems are either unavailable or disproportionately costly. This includes artists, musicians, and educators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. If you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, beats, or any digital product, you will benefit from a system that provides low-cost transactions and full ownership of your customer data. The focus is on enabling creators to profit from their work without the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, allowing them to build sustainable businesses.
Take control of your revenue with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of the COREMERCH infrastructure lies in its carefully selected components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefront, while Google Sheets or Supabase manage order storage. The delivery of digital products is automated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation. NOWPayments handles the crypto payment processing, converting prices in USD at the time of transaction. Together, these elements create a cohesive and efficient system that empowers creators to sell directly to their audiences.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling music online and accepting Bitcoin, first, choose the COREMERCH stack that suits your needs. Deploy your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, then set up the backend with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, upload your music files for instant delivery and configure your marketing strategies to attract customers. With all components in place, you can begin to operate your sovereign online store, free from platform restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack like COREMERCH. This system allows you to host your store independently, manage payments through NOWPayments, and retain full ownership of your data. This architecture circumvents the limitations of conventional platforms, giving you greater freedom and financial control.
Retain ownership of your customer data and sales.

For creators interested in expanding their digital product offerings, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build and scale your own online store. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to find the right solution for your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it a cost-effective solution for accepting payments without needing buyer accounts.
How can I ensure instant delivery of my digital products?
